source_method: Built-in image generation created the transparent finite-event source; deterministic EVAVO finishing crops, registers and validates runtime assets. Approved seamless layer masters provide temporal phase frames.

rules: No recognizable full-screen storm painting is allowed beneath the material stack.
Spatial scrolling stays smooth while water animation uses deliberate held exposures.
Finite events are mission-seeded and do not share the material-loop period.
All temporal material frames close their first and last scanlines exactly.
